gloss: attributive form of copula (used with na-adjectives)

definitions.explanation: The attributive form of the copula だ, used to connect na-adjectives to nouns they modify. This is why these adjectives are called 'na-adjectives' ({形容動詞|けいようどうし}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧。
{綺麗|きれい}な{花|はな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{咲|さ}いている。

notes:
な is the attributive form of the copula だ, used to connect na-adjectives ({形容動詞|けいようどうし}) to the nouns they modify.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [na-adjective] + な + [noun]
- Example: {静|しず}か + な + {部屋|へや} = a quiet room

CONTRAST WITH だ:
- だ is the predicative form (sentence-ending): {静|しず}かだ (It's quiet)
- な is the attributive form (before nouns): {静|しず}かな{部屋|へや} (quiet room)

NOTE: Do not confuse with:
- {名|な} (name) - a noun
- な (sentence-ending particle for commands) - a different particle
